title: The Paper Harbor
author: Jude Winterbourne
blurb: Lena Reyes, a code-carrying courier on the last diplomatic mission of a doomed republic, has spent twenty years learning which silences keep people safe. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must choose which family member gets the last berth before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
